author: KlibrOne
quote: First of all, this game deserves a ZERO purely and solely based on the feminist agenda. When you add 30 fps (which in reality is more like 24-28) even on my PS5 Pro, I would rate this garbage in the negative. Yes the graphics are stunning, yes some of the systems are ambitious, but NONE of that matters when the game is desperate to push an agenda on me. Plus, I can't even do the normal things I could always do in a GTA game and instead I am forced to care for a girl who doesn't give a flying fck about me. A travesty of a "game". In fact, this a propaganda station with a mini game attached to it.
